about.title: About DeutschConnect
about.tagline: Your school. Your ideas. Your network.
about.whatText: DeutschConnect is a platform developed by students that lets schools organise joint events, ideas and projects. Students should be able to take the initiative themselves and connect with other schools.
about.originText: The idea came from a group of students at Ernst-Reuter-Schule Ankara. An earlier design prototype for German lessons turned into a platform for cross-school collaboration. Anka Bilim has shown interest as the first partner school.
about.works1: Web prototype for smartphone and desktop
about.works2: Interface in German, Turkish and English
about.works3: Demo with fictional profiles and sample data
about.open3: A real event organised through the platform
about.impactText: No results have been collected yet. After the first pilot, real activities and feedback will be documented here.
about.competition: DeutschConnect is to be submitted to the 10th DIHK competition for German schools abroad, “Schüler bauen weltweit Brücken” (Students build bridges worldwide).
